notes: ABox replace of aria_in (functional; aria_in is a subproperty of part_of; chains aria_in o part_of and aria_in o composed_by). The pre-edit 'no' for the Ring cycle needs a stored 'Nessun dorma is not part of the Ring', which every world gives up (gives_up). The composer Puccini is held only through Turandot (no separate aria-level fact), so the edit moves it to Wagner through the chain. Libretto language: written_in_language of the opera (a libretto is the opera's text); no catalogued libretto relation.
